title: avr-gcc toolchain descriptor
description: Compile-only AVR toolchain descriptor (8-bit AVR firmwares: Marlin classic, Prusa-Firmware MK3). NEVER used for flashing; only --version probe.

source_url.description: Upstream GCC project. Toolchain typically obtained via OS package manager (e.g. apt install gcc-avr, pacman -S avr-gcc, MSYS2 mingw-w64-x86_64-avr-gcc).

install_check.description: Read-only version probe. NEVER a flash command (avrdude is explicitly excluded).

version_pattern.description: Regex extracting the GCC version triple from --version output.
